agent.title: Agent
agent.sectionSubtitle: Runtime options for simulation agents. Like Claude Code: common settings are visible; the rest live in collapsible panels. Saved to workspace .env with the main Save action.
agent.contextPresetStandardHint: For everyday runs: tighter compaction and smaller tool-result budgets—predictable cost and latency.
agent.contextPresetLongHint: For long tasks and skill-heavy loops: larger thread and tool budgets. Confirm your model/API supports ~1M context.

tools.sectionHint: Always-on tools cannot be turned off. Switches below control which tools PersonAgent can see and call during a simulation step.
tools.disableableNote: Disable via AGENT_DISABLED_TOOLS: {{names}} (Bash uses AGENT_ALLOW_BASH_TOOL separately)

expert.entryHint: Usually leave as-is. Context preset, per-step limits, and built-in tools. Saved with the main config to .env.
expert.modalHint: Blank numeric fields are not written to .env—the preset defaults apply. Each item below explains what it does.
expert.warningIntro: Misconfiguration can break runs, increase cost, or leave extra data in the workspace.
expert.riskCost: Large context windows, tool rounds, or timeouts can sharply increase token cost and latency.
expert.riskStability: Mismatched window vs. model may cause truncation, compaction issues, or mid-run failures.
expert.riskTools: Disabling Bash, codegen/write/batch tools, or dynamic skill commands can break tool-dependent runs.
expert.riskOverride: Filled values override the corresponding preset defaults.

contextPreset.label: Context preset
contextPreset.help: Applies a bundled profile: context window, compaction thresholds, summary and tool-result budgets. Enough for most users.

contextWindow.label: Context window (tokens)
contextWindow.help: Overrides the preset window used for budgeting. Leave blank to follow the preset entirely.

maxToolRounds.label: Max tool rounds per step
maxToolRounds.help: Cap on tool/skill invocations per simulation step. Higher values slow steps and cost more. Blank → default 24.

stepTimeout.label: Step timeout (seconds)
stepTimeout.help: Total time budget per simulation step. Blank → default 600s.

llmRequestTimeout.label: LLM request timeout (seconds)
llmRequestTimeout.help: Per-completion timeout. 0 disables per-request timeout. Blank → default 120s.

checkpointInterval.label: Checkpoint interval (steps)
checkpointInterval.help: How often checkpoints are written. Blank → every 10 steps.

allowBash.label: Bash tool
allowBash.help: Allow Bash in the workspace (still policy-guarded). Off → skills/files only. Default on.

allowDynamicSkills.label: Dynamic skill commands
allowDynamicSkills.help: Allow runtime skill commands from packages. Off → fixed tool set only. Default on.

profileMaxChars.label: Profile max characters
profileMaxChars.help: Truncation before profile enters the identity prompt; also affects surveys. Blank → preset (≈4k standard, ≈8k long).

eqFieldMaxChars.label: Survey field max characters
eqFieldMaxChars.help: Per-field cap in external-question context JSON. Blank → preset.

eqContextMaxChars.label: Survey context JSON max characters
eqContextMaxChars.help: Total size cap for context JSON in survey prompts. Blank → preset.

eqMemoryLimit.label: Survey memory entries
eqMemoryLimit.help: How many recent memory lines to attach when answering surveys. Blank → preset.

eqToolLogsLimit.label: Survey tool-log entries
eqToolLogsLimit.help: How many recent tool logs to attach. Blank → preset.

eqThreadLimit.label: Survey thread messages
eqThreadLimit.help: How many recent thread messages to attach. Blank → preset.

enableLlmHistory.label: Record LLM history
enableLlmHistory.help: Persist LLM traffic under the workspace for debugging. Uses more disk. Default off.

llmHistoryMaxEntries.label: LLM history max entries
llmHistoryMaxEntries.help: Retention cap when history is enabled. Blank → default 100.

advanced.runtimeHint: Override loop, timeout, and tool capability defaults. Leave blank to omit from .env and keep preset defaults.
advanced.surveyHint: Limits for PersonAgent external questionnaires (profile and context truncation).
advanced.debugHint: Enable LLM history only when debugging (uses extra disk).

skillManagement.title: Skill Management
skillManagement.subtitle: Manage installed skills, the remote marketplace, and MCP. Configure market sources and token under page Settings.
skillManagement.subtitleAgent: Installed simulation runtime skills: built-in, env modules, and workspace.
skillManagement.subtitleClaude: Installed Claude / Codex directory skills and bundled templates.
skillManagement.subtitleIntegrations: Sync MCP servers to Claude Code and Codex. Literature search comes from workspace config.
skillManagement.agentTabIntroBody: Same discoverable catalog the simulation uses. Built-in skills ship with the product; env skills come from environment modules; workspace skills are imported or installed from the marketplace. Models select skills on demand—no manual enable/disable.
skillManagement.claudeTabIntroBody: Bundled templates must be synced to the workspace before they take effect. Use the switch to enable or disable loading.
skillManagement.claudeToolbarHint: Import a folder, or sync templates from each card; presets and versions live under More
skillManagement.purgeClaudeConfirmContent: This removes “{{name}}” from disk. You cannot turn it back on from this page. To hide it temporarily, use Deactivate instead.
skillManagement.agentBackendRequiredNotice: Agent runtime skill discovery depends on the local backend. Without it, you can still browse/install Claude Code skills, edit configuration files, and inspect local experiment outputs; agent skill listing, scan, and import require starting the backend first.
skillManagement.agentBackendSectionExplain: Skills shipped with the backend (primarily daily-guidance); appear in the runtime catalog when the backend is online.
skillManagement.agentEnvSectionExplain: Skills provided by loaded environment modules (source=env); appear alongside the environment in the runtime catalog.
skillManagement.agentRegisteredSectionExplain: Skills under custom/skills/; require backend scan or import before they register at runtime.
skillManagement.agentZonesTitle: Three sources — don't mix them up
skillManagement.claudeWorkspaceExplain: Applies only to the folder you have open; marketplace installs and imports usually land here.
skillManagement.claudeGlobalExplain: Shared across projects—good for skills you use everywhere.
skillManagement.vsixTemplateExplain: Sample copies included with the extension for preview; use Sync to workspace to use them in this project.

skillManagement.helpAgentTabDesc: Manage skills used by Agent simulation runtime.
skillManagement.helpAgentTabDescFull: Same discoverable catalog the simulation uses. Built-in skills ship with the product; env skills come from environment modules; workspace skills are imported or installed from the marketplace. All catalog entries are available for on-demand selection—no manual toggles.
skillManagement.helpAgentZones: Sections: Runtime built-in (from backend); Environment module skills (with env modules); Workspace skills under custom/skills/; Remote repos at the bottom for GitHub installs.
skillManagement.helpClaudeZones: Sections: Bundled templates need sync first; This project lists installed skills; Remote repos at the bottom is for browsing and installing.
skillManagement.helpVersionManage: For agentsociety-* skills, use More on a card to switch version or create a snapshot. Version switch is enough for everyday use.
skillManagement.helpAgentEnable: On-demand activation: Catalog skills remain available and the model decides whether to use them on each step.

skillManagement.helpAgentScan: Scan Workspace: Rescan workspace directories to discover new skills.

claudeCodeConfig.restartCodexHint: Close existing Codex terminals and reopen so the latest config applies
claudeCodeConfig.codexOfficialLoginHint: Switching third-party providers will not overwrite official login. Click the status to re-check.
claudeCodeConfig.rectifierHint: Auto-fix common upstream limits before forwarding. The master switch disables all items.
claudeCodeConfig.rectifierThinkingSignatureHint: Strip incompatible thinking blocks and retry when upstream rejects them.
claudeCodeConfig.rectifierThinkingBudgetHint: Fill a reasonable budget_tokens when upstream complains about thinking budget.
claudeCodeConfig.rectifierImageDowngradeHint: Replace image inputs with text placeholders when upstream has no vision support.
claudeCodeConfig.rectifierHeuristicTextOnlyHint: Pre-strip images for common coding/token-plan model names; otherwise downgrade only after upstream errors.
claudeCodeConfig.optimizerHint: Thinking and Cache tweaks for Bedrock upstreams only. The master switch disables all items.
claudeCodeConfig.optimizerThinkingHint: Enable Adaptive Thinking for Opus/Sonnet; inject Extended Thinking for older models.
claudeCodeConfig.optimizerCacheHint: Inject standard 5-minute cache_control breakpoints on tools/system/message anchors.
claudeCodeConfig.providerAddHint: Enter Base URL and API Key, then choose Claude / Codex usage. Protocol is auto-detected after a check. Edit model mapping after saving.
claudeCodeConfig.syncClaudeConfigHint: Rewrite Claude settings from the current default provider without restarting the terminal
claudeCodeConfig.syncCodexConfigHint: Rewrite Codex settings from the current default provider (official login kept); restart Codex afterward
claudeCodeConfig.codexCatalogHint: Updates the Codex model catalog; restart Codex after changing this
claudeCodeConfig.providerQuotaAfterSave: Save the provider first to query quota
claudeCodeConfig.autoMapDone: Filled empty mapping fields from model IDs

claudeCodeConfig.providerCodexSubscriptionHint: ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription: no API Key. After saving as Codex default, run codex login in the terminal.
claudeCodeConfig.gatewayTopologyHint: Maintain one provider list. The local gateway converts requests for Claude Code / Codex, tracks usage, and fails over when needed.

claudeCodeConfig.failoverNeedBackup: Add at least two providers and mark backups
claudeCodeConfig.usageNoData: No usage yet. Stats appear after you enable a proxy and chat.
claudeCodeConfig.usageProbeOnlyTitle: Only model-list requests — no chat usage
claudeCodeConfig.usageProbeOnlyDesc: All {{count}} record(s) come from fetching the model list, not real chats. Turn on Claude local proxy, ensure the provider has an API key, restart Claude Code, then chat again.
claudeCodeConfig.usageProbeOnlyEmpty: Overview excludes model-list requests; check Request log to see them.
claudeCodeConfig.usageClaudeRouteOffTitle: Claude is not using the local gateway
claudeCodeConfig.usageClaudeRouteOffDesc: The local gateway is running, but Claude proxy is off. Chats go direct upstream and will not appear here. Turn on Claude proxy above and restart Claude Code.
claudeCodeConfig.usageRangeEmpty: No usage in this time range. Switch range or view all.
claudeCodeConfig.usageCostIncludesCache: Upstream-reported cost takes priority; otherwise USD estimates separate regular input, output, cache reads, and short/extended cache writes. Provider billing remains authoritative for long-context, processing-tier, regional, and tool surcharges.
claudeCodeConfig.usageTrendNeedMore: The trend appears after usage is recorded on at least two dates
claudeCodeConfig.usageSuccessRateHint: Based on HTTP status in proxy request logs
claudeCodeConfig.usagePricingHint: Common models match built-in reference prices. The gateway also tries OpenRouter and LiteLLM for current observed models and caches those prices. Override relay prices here per million tokens (USD).
claudeCodeConfig.providerConnectionHint: Base URL is the provider endpoint. Third-party or Platform APIs use an API Key; official subscriptions can use login mode.
claudeCodeConfig.providerUsageHint: Checked targets become the primary provider for that CLI. API-key mode uses the local gateway by default; official subscription mode uses the CLI's own login flow.
claudeCodeConfig.providerUseForClaude: Use as Claude Code primary provider
claudeCodeConfig.providerUnifiedModelHint: Map Claude Code roles in the table below; configure Codex default model and 1M in its own section.
claudeCodeConfig.modelDefaultHint: Codex uses this by default; Claude Code also falls back to it when role models are empty.
claudeCodeConfig.advancedSectionNetworkHint: Used for gateway upstream calls and injected into Codex terminals reopened from this page, including sign-in. Existing or other terminals need their own proxy settings; localhost always bypasses it.
claudeCodeConfig.usageEnableRouteHint: Turn on Claude or Codex proxy above to see usage stats.
